name: Example: Data Pipeline with Self-Healing
description: A batch data processing pipeline that uses self-healing to handle partial failures without stopping the entire run.
author: Rana Ahmad — github.com/Ranahmad1
use_case: Process a list of records from an API, enrich each one, and write to a database. If enrichment fails for some records, recover automatically instead of losing the whole batch.

nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.note: Receives a list of record IDs to process

nodes.name: Split Into Items
nodes.note: Processes 10 records at a time to avoid overwhelming the API

nodes.name: Enrich Record (API call)
nodes.note: continueOnFail: true — if one record fails, continue with the rest

nodes.name: → Connect to Error Check in self_healing_workflow
Write to Database (success path)
nodes.note: Only reached on successful enrichment or successful recovery

recovery_behaviors.RATE_LIMIT: Backs off and retries — the batch pauses, then continues
recovery_behaviors.NOT_FOUND: Logs missing record ID, skips it, continues with rest of batch
recovery_behaviors.SERVER_ERROR: Retries up to 3 times with delay
recovery_behaviors.INVALID_DATA: Applies fallback values, writes partial record to DB with flag
recovery_behaviors.AUTH_ERROR: Stops entire batch and escalates to human
